name: obsidian-mdx
//: The Obsidian plugin that opens .mdx files as Markdown notes, a fork of mkozhukharenko/mdx-as-md-obsidian (NOTICE.md), built with esbuild into dist/.

build.//: dist/: main.js and manifest.json, as Obsidian loads a plugin (scripts/build.mjs).

dev.//: Rebuilds dist/ on every change, unminified, with inline source maps.

test.//: The build, loaded as Obsidian loads a plugin, on Node's test runner (test/).

install.//: Run by hand, never by a build: copies dist/ into content/.obsidian/plugins/obsidian-mdx, which git ignores. `--vault=<path>` installs into another vault (scripts/install-in-vault.mjs).
